profile.headline: Graduate from Purdue school of Science, IUPUI # Software Engineer in SRE at Genesys
profile.summary:
- 3+ years of overall experience in Web programming and Development.
- Possessing unusual background in Object Oriented programming and Data Structure as well as experienced in building Third Party API integration like Facebook, Google, Twilio.
- Innovative team player with a passion for continuous learning & building reliable, scalable and secure solutions of sophisticated problems.
- Keen to work with a multi clientele product based organization as a Software Developer, to utilize honed skills in computer science

Skills : 
•	Web Technologies : Angular(versions 6 & 7), Typescript, ReactJs, EmberJs, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Media Queries
•	Backend Development Frameworks : Spring Boot – Java, Hibernate, Spring MVC
•       Scripting : Serverless Framework, Yaml, Cloud Formation
•	Libraries : JQuery, Bootstrap, Angular Material, Nebular UI Toolkit, RxJS
•	Databases : MySQL, SQLServer, NoSQL
•	Cloud Computing Technologies : Fundamentals of Azure, AWS - Lambda, CloudWatch, SecretsManager + Basics
•      Testing Framework : JUnit, Mocha.js, Selenium, Cypress, Chai, Pytest.
•	Programming Languages : Java, Python, C++
•	IDE Tools : Notepad++, Eclipse, Atom, Visual Studio Code, Spring Tool Suit, IntelliJ
•	Version Control System : SVN, GIT, BitBucket
•	Package Managers : NPM, Maven, Brew

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Umbrella: ReactJs, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Python, SQL, Chai, Cypress, Pytest, Serverless Framework, Lambda Cloud Formation, AWS, NewRelic, SumoLogic, Git, BitBucket, PagerDuty
-> As part of Service Reliability Engineering Team, I contribute towards addition and enhancement of features, bug fixing and automation of service deployments within Genesys.
-> Genesys owns more than 10000 microservices in multiple regions. I work to design, build and support the automated CI/CD pipeline to empower production and non-production deployments for them
-> Automation includes 3rd party service provider integrations such as AWS, PagerDuty, SumoLogic, NewRelic
-> Maintain, Monitor and do advancements in existing pipeline by writing serverless cloud formations for AWS lambda functions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer, Intern - Front-end on the Genesys Cloud team, I integrated with a highly skilled team to deliver new features in their product. I got the chance to work on a modern thick client application, utilizing technologies such as : ReactJs, EmberJs, TypeScript, Python, Yaml, Serverless Framework, Cloud Formation, AWS, Chai, Cypress, Pytest, Git, BitBucket
I Contributed to ongoing development and developed a secure gateway by implementing lambda handler in a backend service to get the auth token from AWS SecretsManager and fetched third-party API data. Designed a UI in React, added the endpoint in HTTP proxy-based directory route using python, and implemented a REST API. Wrote unit and integration test cases for API endpoint. Deployed the service with developed API. Maintained versions on bitbucket and worked Agile...!!!

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• This work is a part of research project in area of Human-Computer Interaction.
• Responsible to develop an android app to make typing efficient and easy for the blind and visually impaired through auditory keyboards using android SDK and java.
• Integrated TapStrap using Android SDK to enable gestures and configure typing modes.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Evaluate and grade homeworks, examinations and projects related with data structure and algorithms.
• Schedule and maintain regular office hours to solve student problems of programming assignments.
• Teach programming paradigm concepts like data structures, functional & logical programming to the undergraduate computer science class of Data Structure as well as Concepts of Software Programming with nearly 100 students in both.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Umbrella - Angular 7, Typescript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQL Server, Maven, NPM, SVN, Spring boot framework & Hibernate, Twilio, Java APIs, Azure
Cloud Cockpit - It is a one stop shop for everything at TCS' private cloud. A fully automated environment for private Cloud Service providers featuring report automation, dashboard with multi clientele data from different Data Centers at different locations, trends & graphs, server maintenance charts etc. It provides multi login user based dashboards for client admins to visualize their server capacity, memory/CPU utilization or other data with trends and graphs. 
● Front end and Back end code development for the product.
● Integrated ServiceNow, Solarwinds data through REST API using Twilio and Java.
● Querying and Testing of record entries in database using SQL Server.
● Agile development with daily scrum meetings, iteration demos and deadlines.
● Migration and deployment of project from development to pre-production environment using Azure VMs.

positions.title: Assistant System Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Umbrella - Angular 2 & 6; Typescript, JavaScript, SSMS, HTML/CSS, DevTool Scripting, Azure, AWS, Git, SVN, Agile, Spring boot, Hibernate, Java, Maven, NPM
CloudCounsel - Web application which consults the client in cloud migration from traditional structure. It is a TCS solution for ‘Cloud Strategy Assessment and Roadmaps’. It helps customer determine their cloud adoption and transformation strategy. It provides a fully automated environment for determination of: the right cloud & service models and provide recommendation for PaaS applications and SaaS cloud services as well as runs the assessments to get the recommendations. My responsibilties and contributions were:
● Design the architecture and develop the user interface of the application using angular 2 and 6, typescript, Javascript, HTML/CSS, media queries and DevTool scripting.
● Scripting and building of SQL Server database to store and manipulate data.
● Implement Java APIs using spring boot and hibernate to fetch data.
● Interacting with the team members and BA’s at different locations to design & develop the product and resolve bugs and critical issues.
● Deployment of product on Public Cloud (Azure and AWS).

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed Business Model & User Interface using Java and JavaScript.
Worked on Android SDK for mobile app as well as Hibernate & Java APIs, JSON & XML, SQL Server, automation etc for web application.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Served as Assistant back end developer
Build required APIs for admin & client business logic of ‘Online Car Rental System’ using .NET
Developed Android App integrated with GPS to track mileage of rented cars and make billing
Implemented payment gateway and email services using Java and third party APIs

projects.title: Cloud Cockpit
projects.description: A fully automated environment for private Cloud Service providers like Reporting, extracting data from different Data Centers at different locations. It provides Dashboard for client admin to visualize their server capacity, memory/CPU utilization with trends and graphs. It is a one stop shop for everything at TCS' private cloud.

projects.title: Cloud Counsel
projects.description: This is a tool which accelerate cloud adoption with quick cloud readiness assessment of the technology landscape. It simplifies platform design, manages applications and infrastructure portfolio of clients, includes cloud adoption strategy development, and legacy modernization with TCS’ assessment, discovery, and recommendations. The portal is developed using Angular, core Java, Spring framework, SQL Server DB, Hibernate and Azure deployment services and includes my involvement at a large to design user interface, develop front end and test deployments.
